product_one_liner.value: Disprz is an AI-powered enterprise learning and skilling platform combining learning management, personalized learning experiences and AI content authoring to help organizations train and upskill their workforces.

pricing_page.notes: Public plans page advertises Essentials Learning starting at $2 per learner per month.

employee_band.notes: Company size band reported on its LinkedIn profile.

hq_location.notes: LinkedIn identifies West Orange, New Jersey as headquarters. Disprz labels it its North America HQ and separately lists Chennai, India as its Corporate & Technology HQ.

eng_blog.notes: The reviewed index shows learning-industry, marketing and product content, not two engineer-authored posts explaining how Disprz is built.

public_docs.notes: Public developer portal and API documentation cover user management, learning content, skills, assessments and analytics.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official board lists an AI Content Operations Intern role with an application option. It qualifies under the requested AI-title rule, but is content operations rather than ML engineering.

model_provider.notes: Microsoft's customer story explicitly identifies Azure OpenAI; no specific model version is established by the cited evidence.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims SOC 2 Type II attestation, ISO 27001:2022 certification and GDPR compliance; GDPR is a compliance framework rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Uses the public announcement month, August 2023. The funding database records the same $30 million Series C in May 2023 and lists no later round.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest identified round is the 2023 Series C, before the requested 18-month window; no later round is listed in the funding history reviewed.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official board lists four openings, none with a qualifying SDR, BDR or account executive title. Both located BDR postings explicitly say they are no longer accepting applications.

launched_6mo.notes: Launched Autonomous Enablement OS on September 28, 2026, within the six-month window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Anand Venkatesan's profile lists Senior Vice President & Head of Engineering and states that he has headed engineering at Disprz since March 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Business Operations posting names both in its GTM technology stack and specifies end-to-end ownership of HubSpot.
